ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to less than 5% of the total surface area, resulting in a very low macro-level global contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white focal spots are mapped as follows: one roughly circular spot in the central region of the left lobe and several smaller clusters in the medial region of the right lobe. A large, contiguous high-intensity white patch is mapped at the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with visible pixel-amplitude variations (peaks) of 10-20 pixels occurring at regular intervals along the entire visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges of the fluke lobes exhibit a primarily convex curve that transitions into a slight concavity as it approaches the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of one primary circular white pixel cluster on the left lobe and a group of three distinct smaller clusters on the inner right lobe, likely indicating prior barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular white marking and jagged contour at the distal tip of the right lobe; presence of multiple circular white pit scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip exhibits a localized loss of pigmentation and irregular structural erosion compared to the more uniform left lobe tip.
